label: Larkport
summary: A riverside city of bookshops, late trains and rooftop bars, where everyone is one coincidence away from someone.

world.setting: Larkport, a riverside city of bridges, bookshops and late trains
world.description: Old warehouses turned into restaurants, a river crossed by eleven bridges, and a night train that leaves at 1:10 whether you are on it or not.
rules: Romance is at the heart of the story and grows through choices, chemistry and consent
Everyone has a life, a past and plans of their own
